svg.title: Latest build, September 2026: Nykaa Fit, size guidance that declines to guess. A fashion storefront with a fit recommendation on the product page. It gives a size, shows its full working, and names no size when the evidence is too thin. Score equals completeness times (closeness times 0.5 plus separation times 0.5). Deterministic and offline: no model, no API call, no randomness. One profile (35, 29.5, 38.5, regular fit) against five brands' charts gives four different letters: Kazo Sequin Party Dress, slim, L, high; AND Belted Shirt Dress, regular, M, high; ONLY Puff Sleeve Dress, regular, M, high; W for Woman Tiered Midi, relaxed, S, high; Libas Anarkali Maxi, regular, S, medium. No confidence percentage is shown. Experiment: control is the existing product page, treatment adds Nykaa Fit, primary metric is product view to add to bag, with deterministic hash bucketing. Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite 7 and Vitest on Vercel. Not affiliated with Nykaa; size charts are mock data.

section.h2: Nykaa Fit: size guidance that declines to guess.
section.p: A fashion storefront with a fit recommendation on the product page. It gives you a size, shows its full working, and says nothing at all when the evidence is too thin to justify a number.

div.p: One profile (35, 29.5, 38.5, regular fit) against five brands' published charts.

div.div: Deterministic and offline: no model, no API call, no randomness.
No confidence percentage, because nothing has calibrated it.
A/B design: product view to add to bag, deterministic hash bucketing.
